snippet.title: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2010 (PS3) - Gameplay
snippet.description:
Game: Pro Yakyuu Spirits 2010
Platform: PlayStation 3
Release Year: 2010

A full game, Carp (Kenta Maeda pitching) at Giants, of Prospi 2010 for PS3. This is from Konami's realistic Japanese baseball game series. You can read more about it here: https://30-30.club/encyclopedia/index.php/Pro_Yakyuu_Spirits_2010

***
You can also check out my website about baseball video games at https://30-30.club.
